Overview

Casablanca is a city in Casablanca-Settat with a population of 3,359,000. Morocco’s largest city and economic hub on the Atlantic coast, known for its vibrant markets, Art Deco architecture, and growing business district. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6b growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 287 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews young, with a median age of 30.0.
